name: spreadsheetSetPrintOrientation
description: Sets the print orientation of a sheet to landscape or portrait.

params.name: sheetName
params.description: Sheet to apply to. Defaults to the active sheet.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Does not support sheetName; always applies to the active sheet. Any other orientation value resets to the default. Member form: setPrintOrientation(orientation).

examples.title: Landscape report
examples.description: Set the active sheet to print landscape.
